documents.title: Structuring and Currency Transaction Reporting (illustrative excerpt)
documents.text: Structuring involves breaking transactions into amounts at or below reporting thresholds to evade currency transaction reporting. This excerpt is for developer demo context only and is not legal advice.

documents.title: Customer due diligence (illustrative excerpt)
documents.text: Financial institutions should identify and verify customer identity and understand the purpose of the business relationship. Shared devices or linked accounts may warrant enhanced review. Demo text only; not regulatory guidance.

documents.title: Wire transfer information (illustrative excerpt)
documents.text: Originator and beneficiary information should accompany wire transfers to support tracing. Circular or layered transfers between related accounts can be a red-flag typology in training materials. Not legal advice.

documents.title: Sanctions screening context (illustrative excerpt)
documents.text: Institutions screen customers and counterparties against sanctions lists as part of compliance programs. Retrieved policy text supports reviewer context and must not replace transaction evidence.

documents.title: Reporting thresholds (demo policy note)
documents.text: Demo configuration uses an illustrative USD 10,000 reporting threshold for cash deposits. Values are not legal thresholds. Use only as reviewer context alongside deterministic rule and feature evidence.
